svg.aria-label: Two panels, each with input data flowing through filter 1, filter 2 and filter 3 to output data. Sequential pipeline: record 1 passes filter 1, then filter 2, then filter 3 in time steps 1 to 3, and only then does filter 1 start record 2, so two filters are idle at every step. Concurrent pipeline: a queue sits in front of each filter, so the pipe between filters is a queue instead of a direct call; filter 1 works on record 2 while filter 2 works on record 1, and from step 3 all three filters work on different records at the same time
svg.text: Each grid shows which record each filter works on at each time step.
Sequential pipeline: each filter processes data one after another
Concurrent pipeline: multiple filters process data concurrently on different records
